name: bufu-frontend
description: BUFU frontend — plain static HTML/CSS/JS, no framework, no bundler for app.js. One precompiled artifact: tailwind.css (see BUILD.md) — that's a checked-in static file, deployed as-is like everything else here, not a build step that runs at request time.

scripts.dev: echo 'Static frontend — serve ./frontend with any static file server, e.g. npx serve frontend' && exit 0
scripts.build: echo 'No build step for the app itself. tailwind.css is a checked-in artifact — regenerate it only after adding a new Tailwind class (see BUILD.md), not on every deploy.' && exit 0
scripts.typecheck: echo 'No TypeScript in frontend/ — nothing to typecheck.' && exit 0
